messages:
maria-cs: Hey team — just got pinged by AcmeCorp (org: acme-42) saying their latency dashboard lost the p95/p99 lines after last night's deploy. They see avg and p50 still, but tails are gone. Screenshot attached. Can we triage?
ryan-oncall: Thanks Maria. Can you drop an example dashboard URL + time window and a request id from when they observed it? Also which environment (prod-us-west)?
maria-cs: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/acme-42/dash/latency-ops time window: 2026-03-16T02:00Z -> 03:00Z. Customer saw it at ~02:12Z. No request id from them, they gave curl to our API that returned 200. They said panels show lines for p50/avg but p95/p99 series missing entirely.
sophie-platform: @maria-cs quick question — did they switch to org view or tenant view? We had a transform change that moved some percentile labels into a different tag namespace. If the panel is filtering by metric_name + tag, it may not match.
maria-cs: They were on tenant (org) view. They said it worked earlier in the day. They attached their panel config JSON — showing metric `redwood.request_latency` with quantile tag `quantile:p95` and `quantile:p99` but no series returned.
alan-infra: Deploy-bot shows canary cutover for telemetry-ingest at 2026-03-16T01:58Z -> commit c3f4e2. I'm going to run a quick query against the ingest replicas.
metrics-bot: [alert] Canary flip completed for feature/telemetry-v2 at 2026-03-16T01:58:12Z (rollout 100%).
alan-infra: Running curl against metrics API for org=acme-42: `curl -s "https://metrics.redwood.ai/query?metric=redwood.request_latency&org=acme-42&from=170"` -> response shows series for `quantile:0.5` and `avg` but keys for quantiles 0.95/0.99 are absent.
ryan-oncall: That's consistent with a transform that drops high quantiles to reduce cardinality. Sophie, any FF (feature flag) flips that changed quantile export names or dropped >0.9 quantiles in telemetry-v2?
sophie-platform: We did land a change in telemetry-v2: `reduce_high_quantiles: true` accidentally enabled in the canary manifest for org-scoped streams. The intention was to run it for internal orgs only, not tenant exports. Flag in helm: `telemetry.reduceHighQuantiles = true`. That would strip 0.95/0.99 labels and emit only 0.5/0.9 for memory. Looks like the canary included global scope.
maria-cs: Oh no. Customer is on enterprise plan and expects full tails. They're asking for timeline and when p95/p99 will be back.
alan-infra: I can revert the config on the canary host and trigger a rolling restart of the ingest pipeline. Rolling restart should restore quantile exports within ~45s after the next scrape cycle. I'll coordinate with deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Rolling restart scheduled for telemetry-ingest (canary group) by alan-infra at 2026-03-16T03:10Z.
ryan-oncall: For CS reply: apologize, escalate to Platform with urgency, ETA ~ <1h for fix, and include workaround: add a transient dashboard override to query `quantiles_summary` metric if available or fallback to traces. Also tell customer we will restore full quantiles and follow up when done.
maria-cs: Thanks. I'll message AcmeCorp with the workaround and ETA. Please post here once fixed so I can close the ticket. :pray:
sophie-platform: Follow-up — creating an incident ticket and pruning the FF rules so telemetry.reduceHighQuantiles is only true for internal orgs. Also adding an automated test that validates p95/p99 exist post-deploy for org-scoped exports.
alan-infra: Confirmed revert applied at 2026-03-16T03:09:30Z, rolling restart in progress. Quick smoke: curl query now returns keys including `quantile:0.95` and `quantile:0.99`.
metrics-bot: [info] Telemetry ingest rolling restart completed at 2026-03-16T03:11:04Z. Canary group reports quantile exports restored.
ryan-oncall: Verified customer-facing panel shows p95/p99 lines again around 03:12Z. Maria — safe to close once AcmeCorp confirms.
maria-cs: Replied to customer, they confirmed p95/p99 visible now and dashboard looks correct. Closing ticket and marking postmortem needed (low-sev config drift). Thanks all. :tada:
